paper.title: DeepOHeat: Operator Learning-based Ultra-fast Thermal Simulation in 3D-IC Design

candidates.architecture: multi-input DeepONet; branch networks encode discretized configuration functions and a Fourier-feature trunk maps 3D coordinates
candidates.input_representation: stacked cuboid geometry, boundary-condition functions, material conductivity and 2D or 3D power maps; released showcase uses a 441-value top-surface power map plus 3D query coordinates
candidates.training_objective: data-free physics-informed PDE and boundary-condition residual losses
candidates.dataset_or_cases: procedurally sampled configuration functions; paper validation against Cadence Celsius 3D; released 10-case power-map showcase
candidates.pretrained_or_data_availability: pretrained checkpoints, 10 power maps and Celsius comparison CSV files are included in the repository
candidates.assumptions: axis-aligned stacked cuboids; configuration-specific physics; released showcase fixes geometry, homogeneous conductivity and most boundary conditions

paper.title: DeepOHeat-v1: Efficient Operator Learning for Fast and Trustworthy Thermal Simulation and Optimization in 3D-IC Design
paper.venue: IEEE Transactions on Components, Packaging and Manufacturing Technology; online publication 2025

candidates.architecture: separable physics-informed operator; MLP branch plus three independent order-3 Chebyshev KAN trunks and rank-128 outer-product reconstruction
candidates.input_representation: 441-value surface power map or 10201-value volumetric floorplan/power map plus separable x/y/z query axes
candidates.output_representation: steady 3D temperature field; paper hybrid path additionally evaluates the discrete linear-system residual
candidates.training_objective: full-mesh PDE/source/boundary residual loss; no supervised temperature labels
candidates.dataset_or_cases: surface GRF power maps and random ten-component volumetric floorplans; README links an unmanifested Google Drive folder
candidates.pretrained_or_data_availability: no data, checkpoint, normalization manifest, dependency lock or recorded evaluation artifacts are present in the Git repository
candidates.assumptions: fixed axis-aligned semiconductor stacks; full separable physics mesh; known discrete A/b for confidence and GMRES refinement

paper.title: Therm-FM: Foundation Model is ALL YOU NEED for 3D-ICs Thermal Simulation
paper.venue: arXiv v2 extended version of a DAC 2026 paper; IEEE TCAD listed by upstream as under review

candidates.license_note: The repository README says MIT, but the authoritative LICENSE file is Apache-2.0.
candidates.architecture: Poseidon/scOT shifted-window transformer foundation model adapted at T/B/L scales
candidates.input_representation: regular multilayer grids; steady release uses tensors shaped N x P x L x H x W and per-channel train-split normalization
candidates.output_representation: steady multilayer temperature grids or transient temperature sequences
candidates.training_objective: supervised normalized field loss while fine-tuning a pretrained Poseidon prior; paper also uses thermal-equivalent multi-fidelity adaptation
candidates.dataset_or_cases: HotSpot SC/QC/OC refinement benchmarks and industrial 8-core/32-core steady cases; HotSpot transient cases
candidates.pretrained_or_data_availability: datasets, normalization constants and T/B/L checkpoints released on Google Drive; Poseidon initialization separately available on Hugging Face
candidates.assumptions: grid-aligned layer tensors, benchmark-specific normalization and a pretrained PDE prior; not a from-scratch equal-budget baseline

paper.title: DeepOHeat-v2: Self-Improving Operator Learning for Fast and Trustworthy Thermal Optimization in 3D-IC Design

candidates.architecture: separable operator network with an 8-layer width-256 branch, degree-3 ChebyKAN trunks of width 64 and rank 128
candidates.input_representation: axis-aligned 300 x 300 x 23 F2F chiplet grid with placement configuration and a known discrete FVM operator
candidates.output_representation: full steady temperature grid and peak temperature used inside simulated annealing
candidates.training_objective: discrete energy-form physics loss with Muon2 matrix-preconditioned optimization; online refinement adds supervised MSE on solver-refined cases
candidates.dataset_or_cases: one F2F chiplet placement benchmark with 800x conductivity contrast; random placements plus in-trajectory refined cases
candidates.pretrained_or_data_availability: no verified official code, checkpoint or dataset release found
candidates.assumptions: known FVM matrix, AMG-preconditioned GMRES, trust-gated solver calls and axis-aligned grid-resolved geometry

paper.title: Geometry-Informed Neural Operator for Large-Scale 3D PDEs

candidates.architecture: input GNO from irregular points to a regular latent grid, latent FNO, and output GNO to query points
candidates.input_representation: geometry point cloud or SDF, input functions and boundary conditions plus an explicit regular latent query grid
candidates.output_representation: field values on arbitrary output query points
candidates.training_objective: supervised field regression with relative Lp-style evaluation
candidates.dataset_or_cases: paper CarCFD surface-pressure data with 500 car geometries and varying inlet velocities; maintained repository also contains Poisson and CarCFD recipes
candidates.pretrained_or_data_availability: CarCFD resources and demonstration checkpoints are public; unit/model tests need no external data
candidates.assumptions: radius-neighborhood GNO connectivity and a chosen latent-grid resolution; batching may require shared geometry

paper.title: Transolver: A Fast Transformer Solver for PDEs on General Geometries

candidates.architecture: point embedding followed by Physics-Attention that slices points into learned physical-state tokens, performs token attention and deslices to points
candidates.input_representation: structured or irregular point coordinates plus optional pointwise functions and time
candidates.training_objective: supervised field regression; official standard benchmarks train against relative L2-style TestLoss
candidates.dataset_or_cases: six FNO/Geo-FNO PDE benchmarks plus ShapeNetCar and AirfRANS design tasks
candidates.pretrained_or_data_availability: standard benchmark datasets are public; the repository provides scripts but no canonical pretrained standard-benchmark checkpoint
candidates.assumptions: slice count, token width and point sampling are architecture parameters; no regular latent grid or external solver is required at inference

paper.title: Fourier Neural Operator with Learned Deformations for PDEs on General Geometries

candidates.maintenance_status: deprecated_by_upstream; NeuralOperator is the recommended maintained codebase, but it does not expose a drop-in reproduction of every original script
candidates.architecture: learned physical-to-latent coordinate deformation followed by nonuniform Fourier transforms and latent-grid FNO layers
candidates.input_representation: point clouds, meshes or design parameters plus coordinates and optional deformation code
candidates.output_representation: field values on the physical mesh or query points
candidates.training_objective: supervised relative Lp field loss with an optional deformation regularizer
candidates.dataset_or_cases: elasticity, plasticity, airfoil Euler flow and pipe Navier-Stokes, including forward and inverse-design tasks
candidates.pretrained_or_data_availability: paper datasets are public on Google Drive; no canonical pretrained checkpoint is included
candidates.assumptions: learnable deformation to a regular latent domain; original code is pinned to old dependency and CUDA conventions
